rationale: These shared profile/contract families define typed composition, provenance, routing and mediation boundaries. Eligibility, permissions, provider/model routing, resource admission, tool mediation and runtime promotion remain deterministic under existing Model Router, Security Governance, MCP/UAF, HRB and evidence gates. The shared layer must not rank candidates, expand eligible sets, grant permissions, select providers/models, create agents or promote runtime evidence. Existing consumers may independently use the already-canonical Decision Fabric after their own deterministic eligibility checks.
not_delegated: model or provider eligibility and routing authority
host resource admission placement or leasing

project_radar_review.scope: Five shared AI composition profile/contract families against existing FA3 Decision Fabric boundaries
project_radar_review.note: Shared composition is deterministic and authority-neutral; any advisory ranking remains in already-admitted consumer workflows.
